privacy.ai_training_note: Terms of service state customers retain rights to submitted/generated content, and that Hypotenuse may collect usage data to improve the Services 'solely in aggregate or other de-identified form' - i.e. no training of models on identifiable customer content by default. Vendor messaging states data is 'never shared with third parties or used to train public AI models.' Note: the public privacy policy itself does not explicitly address model training, so the binding commitment lives in the ToS / enterprise contract; underlying third-party LLM subprocessors are not named.
